messages.subject: Strange dataProcess Function Behavior
parts:
Hi MSstats,

I have a query regarding a Spectronaut dataset I have generated and how MSstats summarised it. I have attached the Spectronaut boxplot figure from it's software, the MSstats dataProcessPlots QC plot and a box plot I made using the ProteinLevelData from the dataProcess output (using the LogIntensities column). You can see that my plot and Spectronaut's plot look quite similar, but the QC Plot shows "Back Rep2" box going down to 0. I have used censoredInt = "0" and "NA" and MBimpute = TRUE.

I can share my dataset with you privately for you to take a look at.

Best wishes,
Amandeep

messages.author: 6597c45f2a31b5d0
messages.subject: Re: Strange dataProcess Function Behavior
parts:
Hi,

From my understanding, QCPlot in MSstats uses FeatureLevelData to generate box plots, not ProteinLevelData, which I believe is why you're seeing some discrepancies.  In your situation, some features can be very low abundance, but depending on how you summarize your features to the protein level, the effect of those low abundance features could get diminished after summarization.

Thanks,
Tony
